/**
 * Tests for POST /api/slack/interactivity.
 *
 * Phase 1 scaffold coverage (request validation + routing shape):
 *   - Misconfigured signing secret (env missing)
 *   - HMAC signature verification: valid, invalid, missing, stale, tampered
 *   - URL-encoded body parsing: missing payload field, malformed JSON
 *   - Routing by `payload.type`:
 *       block_actions   -> known/unknown action_id branches
 *       view_submission -> known/unknown callback_id branches
 *       view_closed     -> NotImplementedError (Wave 11 wires)
 *       shortcut        -> 200 OK
 *       unknown         -> 400
 *
 * Wave 8 (Builder 8) coverage extends Phase 1 with the wired dispatchers:
 *   - block_actions/open_create_modal happy path (task + project + retainer +
 *     team-member; multi-match hint matrix; expired/submitted ephemeral)
 *   - block_actions/is_retainer_checkbox -> response_action: update
 *   - block_actions/task_button_disabled -> ephemeral when not yet resolved
 *   - block_actions/target_entity_picker -> views.update with currentValues
 *   - view_submission -> inngest.send dispatched with locked schema, HTTP 200
 *
 * Wave 11 still owns view_closed; the original Phase 1 NotImplementedError
 * test for that branch is kept verbatim.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from "vitest";
import {
  loadFixture,
  makeSlackSignature,
  mutateFixture,
  nowTimestamp,
} from "@/lib/slack/test-helpers";

new_string: - [DONE] Phase 3 / Builder 8 — interactivity action handlers + caller-side fuzzy match + multi-detect chat.update helper. Wired 4 block_actions branches (open_create_modal / is_retainer_checkbox / task_button_disabled / target_entity_picker) and view_submission inngest dispatch in `src/app/api/slack/interactivity/route.ts` (252 → 681 LOC, +429 LOC). open_create_modal loads proposal, validates lifecycle (expired/submitted/cancelled → ephemeral), runs caller-side `getProjectsFiltered` + `fuzzyMatchCandidates` for parent-picker hints, dispatches to the right view builder (task/project/team-member, retainer mode for Project) and calls `views.open`. baselineHint + multiMatchHint both stay undefined when args has no parent name OR retainerMode is on (per Builder 8 spec). is_retainer_checkbox returns Builder 5's `buildEphemeralRetainerToggle` payload as `response_action: update`. task_button_disabled posts ephemeral `TASK_BUTTON_DISABLED` from copy.ts when resolvedProjectId is null; logs warn when already resolved (defensive). target_entity_picker persists targetEntityId/Type and re-renders via `views.update`. view_submission returns HTTP 200 with empty body and dispatches `inngest.send({name: "slack-modal/submit", data: {...}})` matching the locked schema in `src/lib/inngest/client.ts` (modalCallbackId / stateValues / userId / teamId / channelId / threadTs / triggerId / submittedAt). New: `src/lib/slack/modals/multi-detect.ts` (261 LOC) `reEmitButtonsAfterParentSave(parentProposalId, resolvedProjectId, savedProjectName, slack, db)` — looks up parent, scans siblings by intentGroupId, marks ones whose pendingProjectName matches resolved, then re-emits via `chat.update` with new actions block where `value` is always proposalId (per §B2) and `action_id` flips between `task_button_disabled` and `open_create_modal`. Falls back to `chat.postMessage` on cant_update_message / message_not_found / edit_window_closed. Bails gracefully when parent has no postedMessageTs. New tests: `multi-detect.test.ts` (472 LOC, 9 tests) + extensions to `route.test.ts` (316 → 914 LOC, +34 tests). Tests: 2653 passed / 19 skipped (+18 net new vs Phase 2 baseline of 2635). Lint: 0 errors / 11 pre-existing warnings. Commit sha: 63c380c (worktree branch builder-8-interactivity off feature/slack-modal at 8f5b3b7). **Out-of-scope observations:** (1) Builder 7's open follow-up #1 — `posted_message_ts` / `posted_message_channel` aren't yet persisted on intercepted proposals after `chat.postMessage` returns; multi-detect.ts depends on those fields being set, otherwise it bails gracefully. Builder 10 or a follow-up should add an `updatePostedMessage()` helper. (2) `view_closed` (Wave 11 / Builder 11) still throws `NotImplementedError` per scope. (3) Inngest event `slack-modal/submit` payload field is `triggerId` (not optional `triggerId` as the prompt suggested) — locked schema in `client.ts` enforces all fields including channelId/threadTs/triggerId. Builder 8 resolves channelId/threadTs from the proposal row. (4) Phase 1 vintage describe block titles use em-dash (`"POST /api/slack/interactivity — request validation"`); kept the convention to match existing style. New describe titles for Builder 8 suites also use em-dash; only user-facing string LITERALS are em-dash-free. (5) Initial worktree HEAD was on a wrong branch (worktree-agent-ac86d870 off main); halted, then operator-supplied recovery sequence (`git checkout -b builder-8-interactivity feature/slack-modal`) brought HEAD to 8f5b3b7 before any code was written.
